title: APEC summit: Putin, Xi meet ahead of trilateral talks with Trump
summary: US President Donald Trump is set to travel to the Chinese tech hub of Shenzhen for a much-anticipated meeting with Russian and Chinese counterparts. Follow DW live.
byline: Karl Sexton, Wesley Dockery, Mahima Kapoor

image.caption: Xi greeted Trump at Shenzhen airportImage: Carlos Barria/REUTERS

blocks.text: Donald Trump arrives at Shenzen Airport ahead of summit

blocks.caption: Xi and Trump embraced upon the latter's arrivalImage: Carlos Barria/REUTERS

blocks.text: US President Donald Trump has landed at Shenzen Airport on Air Force One and disembarked.
He left Manila in the Philippines a few hours earlier.
Trump will be attending the APEC summit but is also expected to take part in a three-way meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping on Thursday.
Xi greeted Trump at the airport on Wednesday, mirroring a gesture Trump had recently extended during the Chinese leader's state visit to the US in September.
